name: Unwarp unwrapWETH pays out more than it receives
summary: unwrapWETH(uint256,address) released the caller-supplied amount of ether to the caller-supplied recipient without checking it against what the caller had actually deposited, so a flash-loaned 100.85 WETH transfer was redeemed for 104.83 ETH.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
